name: Prevent alteration of ML models in Non-RT-RIC Workloads
description: Adversaries may gain unauthorized access to machine learning model files, which can lead to model poisoning or other forms of manipulation.
remediation: Create admission control policies to enforce strict access control to infrastructure and application supporting AI/ML operations.
long_description: A nefarious change on ML models or data can cause drastic change in behavior of O-RAN components including network outage.
